name: sunderfall
description: Sunderfall: a collectible card battler for mobile. Single-file HTML5 build, AI opponents, campaign, guided tutorial.

scripts.check: node build.js && node --check dist/bundle.js && node test/scope.js dist/bundle.js
scripts.test: npm run check && node test/sim.js && node test/ui-flow.js && node test/tutorial-flow.js
scripts.shots: node build.js && python test/shots.py shots && python test/tutshots.py shots
